summary: Full-stack data science project “Smart Agriculture System using Data Science” with a React frontend and Python (Flask/FastAPI) backend to: predict crop yield (Random Forest), detect plant diseases from leaf images (CNN), and recommend irrigation needs, including dashboards/visualizations, authentication, training scripts, database, and production-ready structure.
architectural_notes: Tech stack decision: React.js frontend + Python backend (Flask or FastAPI) serving ML inference APIs
ML stack: scikit-learn for Random Forest regression; TensorFlow/Keras for CNN image classification
Database option: SQLite for local/dev; MySQL for production-ready deployment
Visualization: Chart.js on frontend and/or Matplotlib for generated plots
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimal farm-themed app logo (smart-agri-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Wide dashboard hero illustration with fields, sensors, and crops in a clean flat style (dashboard-hero.dim_1600x600.png)

existing_features.title: Implement a clean dashboard UI with separate pages for: (1) Crop Yield Prediction, (2) Plant Disease Detection (leaf image upload), (3) Smart Irrigation Recommendation, plus a (4) Data Visualization page that summarizes results across modules.
Add a coherent, distinctive visual theme and apply it consistently (colors, typography, spacing, card styles, form controls) across all pages without using a blue/purple primary palette.

Crop Yield Prediction module: implement an end-to-end flow that accepts inputs (Soil Type, Rainfall mm, Temperature °C, Humidity %, Fertilizer Usage), returns Predicted Yield (tons/hectare) and an Accuracy Score, and renders at least one graph visualization on the frontend.
Plant Disease Detection module: provide a leaf image upload UI, send the image to the backend, and return Disease Name, Confidence Percentage, and Suggested Treatment.

Smart Irrigation Recommendation module: implement an end-to-end flow that accepts inputs (Soil Moisture Level, Weather Condition, Temperature) and returns Water Required (liters/acre) and Irrigation Recommendation (Yes/No).
Add a visualizations page that compares module outputs and “model accuracy comparison” charts using a frontend charting library.
Implement authentication using Internet Identity and gate history/persistence features behind the authenticated principal (no custom username/password storage).
Add robust error handling end-to-end: client-side validation, backend input validation, and consistent error messaging in the UI.

Provide production-ready project documentation: README with local run steps for the Internet Computer template, clear module descriptions, and how to test each API from the frontend; add code comments where necessary to explain data flow and assumptions.
Create a “History” section (either per module or centralized) that lists the authenticated user’s saved runs with timestamps and the key output fields, and allows clearing history.

new_feature_requests.summary: React.js clean dashboard UI with separate pages for Crop Yield Prediction, Plant Disease Detection, and Smart Irrigation modules
Backend API (Flask or FastAPI) exposing endpoints for all ML models with robust error handling
Crop Yield Prediction module using Random Forest Regression with sample training dataset; outputs predicted yield, accuracy score, and graphs
Plant Disease Detection module: leaf image upload + CNN trained on PlantVillage; outputs disease, confidence %, and suggested treatment
Smart Irrigation Recommendation module: takes soil moisture/weather/temperature; outputs water required and irrigation yes/no recommendation
Data visualization dashboard including model accuracy comparison (charts via Chart.js/Matplotlib)
Model training scripts, preprocessing pipeline, and saved model artifacts for each module
Database integration (MySQL or SQLite) with schema for users/auth and any needed app data
Basic authentication (login/signup) integrated into frontend and backend
Production-ready project structure with README, requirements.txt, code comments, sample dataset, and local run instructions
Create a Motoko backend (single main actor) that exposes typed APIs for the three modules and stores per-user history of predictions/results in stable storage.
Include sample datasets/artifacts in-repo as static assets suitable for demo/visualization (e.g., a small CSV/JSON for agriculture yield examples and a small label/treatment mapping for diseases).
